svg.text: 48 authored secondary settlements and communities · 12 major-city anchors · 742 AL census allocation
Equirectangular concept map; angular scale distorts distance. Marine symbols are reference anchors, not engineered settlement footprints.
Rust diamonds: existing major cities. Blue dots: marine communities. Dashed rust line: proposed Sola–Veyra–Aven connection.
34.8 million habitual residents allocated once across 24 regional accounts. Named places are subsets of those accounts.
Concept placement and bookkeeping checked; settlement footprints, source capacity, terrain and operating transport remain to be developed.
Source: nacre_population_and_settlements.json and parent atlas. This plate is not a playable world or a population simulation.
